segments.thag2.16:1.1: “Kāḷī itthī brahatī dhaṅkarūpā, satthiñca bhetvā aparañca satthiṃ;
segments.thag2.16:1.3: Bāhañca bhetvā aparañca bāhaṃ, sīsañca bhetvā dadhithālakaṃva;
segments.thag2.16:2.1: “Yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkhamupeti mando;
segments.thag2.16:2.3: Tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, māhaṃ puna bhinnasiro sayissan”ti [passissanti (ka.)].
